Definition: to end (in the sense of completion or failure)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to end, come to an end, complete, cease; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to come to an end, be no more; 1a2) to bring to an end, complete; 2) (TWOT) to fail, perfect, perform
